authoring.author: claude (kinkerstraat even-side faces lane)
authoring.note: Kinkerstraat 332-244 (even side, Jan Pieter Heijestraat to Ten Katestraat, 187 m), 2024-12-11 overcast strip, one intent (compiles within the gates; no bend to split at). 1897-1899 shop rows: kinker-1890-brick-arched where the photo shows white blocked heads and courses (332-320, 302-294, 286-280, the yellow-coursed 258-252), kinker-1890-plain-brick with segmental heads (318-306) or keystone flat heads (278-270, 260), a black-painted 304, three painted fronts 268-264 (kinker-1900-stucco-front), and two post-war rebuilds on the infill type with their own grids (288-292, 1990; 244-248, BAG 1897 but a post-war dark brick block). Every shop is lettered except where noted.
